errors.text_span: ЕС (Европейски съюз): Показва се с черна пунктирна линия. Стойността започва при около 22% през 2000 г. и се стабилизира около 20% от 2005 до 2015 г., след което се издига леко до около 22% през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description for EC (EU) incorrectly describes the line style and its values. It states the line is dotted ("пунктирна") and starts at 22%, when in the figure the EC line is long-dashed ("--") and stays around the 5% level throughout the period. The description provided is actually for the Japan line.
The line style for Japan is described as "черна пунктирна линия с точки" (black dotted line with dots), which is an awkward and inaccurate description for a dash-dot line (- ⋅ -).
The word "сплошна" is a non-standard word or typo. The correct term for a solid line in Bulgarian is "плътна".
